title: Open Bench makers arrive
author: Ivo Maren
summary: Three makers install benches in the Workshop Gallery for the winter season.
body:
Tov Ren, Mira Solen and Cal Orth will work Thursday through Saturday through January 18.

Visitors watch from the rail; tools on the wall are labeled do-not-touch.

title: New wall labels in Tool Hall
author: Jonah Vale
summary: Every object in The Measured Hand now carries a full accession label.
body:
Labels list accession number, maker, date, materials and credit line.

Members can download the packet of all labels from the members room.

title: School desk hours expand
author: Tess Branek
summary: The school desk in Entry Hall now opens at 9 am on weekdays.
body:
Teachers can pick up paper packets without an appointment.

Digital packets for members stay behind sign-in.

title: Study Vault table booking
author: Oda Helmers
summary: Members book reading tables for the third Thursday evening.
body:
Request objects at least three days ahead.

The vault is not a public gallery.

title: River Packing show closes
author: Nell Orth
summary: The loan crates returned; packing checklist stays in the archive.
body: Photographs and the crate stamp remain available to members by request.

title: Docent class for spring
author: Rae Colmin
summary: A new docent training cohort begins in January.
body: Applications are taken at the desk; there is no form on this site.
